description: This file implements the RefImsMedia class, which manages IMS media sessions, including setting listeners, opening, and closing sessions within the Android radio IMS media interface.

classes.name: RefImsMedia
classes.description: Class responsible for managing IMS media sessions, including setting listeners and handling session lifecycle events.

methods.name: setListener
methods.description: Sets the media listener for IMS media events.

methods.name: openSession
methods.description: Opens a new IMS media session with specified session ID, local endpoint, and RTP configuration.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes an existing IMS media session identified by session ID.
